title: Debug: The Hand-Rolled Modal
prompt: This page's 'modal' is a div with role="dialog" toggled by a class, and its FAQ accordions are <details> whose name attributes disagree, one with an empty summary. Rebuild properly: a real <dialog> opened via a button using commandfor/command (or form method="dialog"/script showModal with its id), accordions sharing ONE name, and no empty summaries.
boilerplate:
Workspace settings

Delete workspace?

Can I undo?

No.

Maybe.

tests.name: real dialog replaces the div
tests.hint: role="dialog" on a div gets none of the platform: no top layer, no inert page, no Escape.

tests.name: dialog is actually openable
tests.hint: Either the 2026 way (command/commandfor) or one showModal() line — but something must open it.

tests.name: accordions share one name
tests.hint: 'faq-open' vs 'faq-closed' are two separate groups — pick one name for both.

tests.name: no empty summaries
tests.hint: The summary is the accessible name of the disclosure — empty means invisible to users.
